subject: Request: CEO sign-off for one-off POC bridging credit
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cloudsync.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short POC extension + one-off credits (need by EOD)

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — CloudSync is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. We started an internal eval this week and are hitting token limits in our sandbox. Our security team needs another 21 days to complete the SOC‑2 scoping, but the PLG sandbox expires in 7 days.

We'd like to request a one-off bridging grant: 30k free inference tokens and an additional 21‑day POC window. This is outside the standard PLG allowance; our procurement lead wants a quick written approval to move forward. Can you escalate to your execs for an exception?

I attached a quick mutual action plan and a usage snapshot.

Best,
Ellen Park
Director of Data Products
CloudSync, Inc.

Attachments: CloudSync_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf (application/pdf), usage_snapshot.csv (text/csv)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Short POC extension + one-off credits (need by EOD)

Aditya / Grace — forwarding a high-velocity request from CloudSync. They punched in a PLG eval and are asking for 30k complimentary inference tokens + 21 days. If we don't take care of this, they risk dropping out mid-eval and the deal (SMB→midmarket) could slip.

Key context:
- Sales motion led by Grace (intro from last quarter).
- Probable ARR: $85k first-year recurring if POC converts.
- They require SOC‑2 scoping done during extended window.

Laura — can you advise on any contractual or legal exposure if we grant a one-off token uplift? Grace, can you confirm we don't have an existing promo that covers this?

Asking for a quick exec stamp if possible this afternoon.

Thanks,
Mike

--
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, North America
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short POC extension + one-off credits (need by EOD)

Mike/Aditya — brief clarifications on pipeline and upside:
- CloudSync's current sandbox usage is ~7k tokens/day; 30k would safely cover the next 4 days but not the full 21 days. I recommend 120k tokens to cover their expected cadence for 21 days.
- Close probability with extension: 65% (marketing workflow + integrations they demoed).
- Upside includes potential Dedicated purchase in H1 2027.

If Aditya is comfortable with a one-off exception, I'd ask for: 120k tokens + 21 day extension, and a required Mutual Action Plan signed within 5 business days (attached). We can gate the extra tokens behind the signed MAP and a short POC success checklist.

Grace
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short POC extension + one-off credits (need by EOD)

Folks — quick legal note: granting free tokens generally carries minimal long‑term exposure if we treat them as a one-time promotional credit tied to an execution milestone (MAP signed + POC checklist). Two items to document:
1) Credit Concession Addendum (short form) appended to the MAP outlining the amount, expiry, and gating conditions.
2) Limit on refund/chargebacks: ensure credit cannot be converted to monetary credit outside the MAP.

If finance wants a dollar-equivalent cap, suggest we record 120k tokens = $1,800 (for internal reporting). Otherwise legal is fine with the approval path.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short POC extension + one-off credits (need by EOD)

Thanks for the context. Approve one-off exception with these conditions:
- Grant 120,000 complimentary inference tokens and a 21-day extension to the existing sandbox.
- Condition: CloudSync must sign the attached Mutual Action Plan and the Credit Concession Addendum within 5 business days and complete the POC success checklist.
- Credit expires if mapping/milestone not signed by the deadline and will be revoked.
- Finance to record a notional value of $1,800 for internal reporting; no invoicing or refunds.

Grace — please communicate the decision to Ellen and attach the MAP + addendum. Laura — please send the short-form addendum for signature and the final language for the gating conditions. I'll loop in CS if they need to set a token bucket on the sandbox.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
